scope: Root-authorized secondary descriptive tissue-supported lineage scorer; no change to primary family or marker choices
truth: Exact patient/tumour primary-only native cluster mapping via owned variant coordinates to future corrected tree; require nontrunk, eligible native reference>=3, metachronousMet tissue, and audited multimarker_future_lineage_support=True (same future region >=3 shared own positive markers with depth>=20,alt>=3). Author multimarker seeding support is an additional separately labeled target endpoint, not lineage-theta equivalence.
plasma_detection: Already frozen >=2 positive owned markers from saved CLONE_DETECTIONS; no new threshold or plasma rerun; selected-only if supported by independent future tissue may count for this descriptive endpoint, primary whole-reference recall unchanged.
capacity: Future targets with >=2 valid surgical PSP markers count as plasma-measurable; targets below2 remain denominator/capacity table, not removed. Patients with no paired future tissue or no eligible target remain explicit NA, not biological negative or zero success.
time: All postoperative detection union plus secondary before true Table8 recurrence only. Never invent dates for patients with future tissue but no explicit Table8 recurrence date.
statistics: Patient-level descriptive means only; report dev/confirmation and sourcepair/target/capacity/available plasma counts; no new confirmatory family, no tuning.
